_doc: Motedis' Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5): a zinc die-cast inner connector that lies hidden in the slots of two 20 mm B-type profiles where they meet, clamped by an M5x6 grub screw in each leg. No machining. Sizes from Motedis' drawing, the price from its shop page.
name: fitting-motedis-inner-20-b6

fitting_kind.rule: An inner angle that lies in the slots of both beams, out of sight
fitting_kind.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Innenwinkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6-M5

series.rule: Made for 20 mm profiles of B type
series.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Innenwinkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6-M5

slot.rule: Made for the 6 mm B-type slot: 6 mm wide where it stands in the opening, 9.5 mm under the lips
slot.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Innenwinkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6-M5; Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BIBM5-Drawing_2.pdf

material.value: zinc die cast, zinc plated (Zinkdruckguss verzinkt)
material.rule: As the shop page names it; its screws are zinc-plated steel
material.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Innenwinkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6-M5

thread.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Innenwinkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6-M5; Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BIBM5-Drawing_2.pdf

screw_form.rule: DIN 913 grub screws (set screws), in the connector, pressing on the slot
screw_form.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BIBM5-Drawing_2.pdf

screw_length.rule: M5x6, as the drawing names them
screw_length.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BIBM5-Drawing_2.pdf

screw_count.rule: One in each leg, part of the connector as sold
screw_count.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BIBM5-Drawing_2.pdf

leg.rule: The leg in b's slot, 25.5 mm from the outside of its corner
leg.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BIBM5-Drawing_2.pdf

leg_a.rule: The leg in a's slot, 24.85 mm
leg_a.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BIBM5-Drawing_2.pdf

width.rule: Across, under the lips: 9.5 mm (6 mm where it stands in the opening)
width.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BIBM5-Drawing_2.pdf

thickness.rule: Each leg 4.4 mm deep into the slot
thickness.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BIBM5-Drawing_2.pdf

holes_b.rule: The grub screw in b's leg, 6 mm from its end (25.5 - 6 from the corner)
holes_b.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BIBM5-Drawing_2.pdf

holes_a.rule: The grub screw in a's leg, 7 mm from its end (24.85 - 7 from the corner)
holes_a.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BIBM5-Drawing_2.pdf

cost.rule: One in a pack of 10: 6.53 EUR the pack with 20% VAT (5.44 EUR without), on the date checked, its grub screws in
cost.source: Motedis, Innenwinkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BIBM5), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Innenwinkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6-M5

bending_stiffness.rule: How stiffly this inner connector, its grub screws tight, holds a beam's end against turning across its axis, its screws tight. The maker gives no figure, so this is frames' working guess for this kind of join (JOIN_STIFFNESS.hidden), until the joint rig measures it
bending_stiffness.source: A working guess of @rulecad/frames, with no measurement or published figure behind it: the joint rig (issue 264) measures it and cad measured replaces it

twist_stiffness.rule: How stiffly this inner connector, its grub screws tight, holds a beam's end against twisting about its own axis. The maker gives no figure, so this is frames' working guess (JOIN_STIFFNESS.hidden), until the joint rig measures it
twist_stiffness.source: A working guess of @rulecad/frames, with no measurement or published figure behind it: the joint rig (issue 264) measures it and cad measured replaces it
